title: Resolve recurring citation and attribution issues in Codex clip drafts
notes: All three Codex validation drafts on 2026-11-24 reached automatic review. Each verdict raised a source-marker issue. Two verdicts also raised claims presented as fact, and one questioned whether it had enough unchanged context to judge a rewrite.
done_when: Determine whether the flagged markers fail to resolve in the full draft or are unverifiable from the review input. Address the confirmed causes and check that source-reported claims are explicitly attributed in a replay.
